title: 碧風の航海日誌と、雲下に眠る花びら
author: 灯守 ルカ

en.title: The Azure Wind's Logbook and the Petals Sleeping Beneath the Clouds
en.premise: As a cartographer, "I" travel the world in a small steam airship, recording the stories of forgotten lands. One day, I stumble upon fragmentary information about a legendary city said to be sunken beneath a sea of clouds, and the "eternal cherry blossoms" rumored to bloom there. Driven by curiosity and a quiet yearning, I set off on a journey into the unknown depths.

zh.title: 碧风的航海日志与沉眠云下的花瓣
zh.premise: 身为地图制作师的“我”，驾驶着小型蒸汽飞行艇游历世界，记录着那些被世人遗忘的土地。有一天，我得到了关于一座据说沉没于云海之下的传奇都市，以及那里绽放的“永恒樱花”的零星情报。在好奇心与静谧憧憬的驱使下，我踏上了驶向未知深海的旅程。
